name: com.testingapis/api-tools
title: TestingAPIs API tools
description: Validate OpenAPI and JSON Schema, convert specs, curl to code, JSONPath, and free test data.

tools.name: validate_openapi
tools.description: Check an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 or Swagger 2.0 document (JSON or YAML) for the mistakes that break tools: missing required fields, undeclared path parameters, invalid status codes, duplicate operationIds, broken $refs, undefined security schemes and examples that don't match their schema. Returns each problem with a JSON pointer and, for JSON, a line number.

spec.description: The whole OpenAPI or Swagger document, as JSON or YAML text.

tools.name: validate_json_schema
tools.description: Check a JSON document against a JSON Schema (drafts 4 to 2020-12, with $ref, allOf/anyOf/oneOf, if/then/else and formats). Returns every error with the JSONPath of the value and the keyword that failed.

schema.description: The JSON Schema, as JSON text.

data.description: The JSON document to check, as JSON text.

tools.name: generate_json_schema
tools.description: Create a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) from a JSON sample. Every item in an array is read, so required, optional and nullable properties are worked out, and strings that are all dates, emails, URLs or UUIDs get a format.

json.description: A JSON sample, such as an API response.

strict.description: Add additionalProperties: false to every object.

tools.name: json_to_types
tools.description: Generate types for a JSON sample in TypeScript, Go (with json tags), Python (Pydantic), Java (records with Jackson), C# (System.Text.Json), Kotlin (kotlinx.serialization) or Rust (serde). Optional and nullable fields are worked out from every item in arrays.

json.description: A JSON sample, such as an API response.

rootName.description: Name of the top-level type; Root by default.

tools.name: curl_to_code
tools.description: Turn a cURL command (bash, Windows cmd or PowerShell, as copied from browser devtools) into the same request in Python requests, JavaScript fetch or axios, Go, Java, C#, PHP, or a tidy cURL command. Headers, body, auth, timeouts and redirects are carried over.

tools.name: convert_api_spec
tools.description: Convert between API description formats: OpenAPI 3, Swagger 2.0, a Postman collection, cURL commands or a HAR recording in; OpenAPI 3.1 (JSON or YAML), Swagger 2.0, a Postman collection v2.1, cURL commands or an .http file out. Anything the target format can't hold is listed.

source.description: The API description: OpenAPI or Swagger (JSON or YAML), a Postman collection, cURL commands or a HAR file.

tools.name: query_jsonpath
tools.description: Evaluate a JSONPath expression (RFC 9535: filters like $..book[?@.price < 10], slices, recursive descent, length/count/match/search) against JSON. Returns each match with its normalized path.

tools.name: explain_cron
tools.description: Read a cron expression (5 fields as in crontab, GitHub Actions and Kubernetes, or 6 with seconds as in Spring/Quartz, or @daily and the other shortcuts) in plain English, and list its next run times in UTC.

count.description: How many next run times to list (5 by default).

tools.name: compare_json
tools.description: List the differences between two JSON documents by their data, not their text: key order never counts, and array order can be ignored. Each difference has its JSONPath and both values.

ignoreArrayOrder.description: Match array items by content instead of position.

tools.name: get_test_data
tools.description: Fetch realistic sample records from the free testingapis.com API to use as test data or fixtures: products (with prices, categories, ratings), blog posts or todos. Every record comes from a real, public REST endpoint the user can also call.

id.description: One record by its id, instead of a list.
